query:
MATCH p = TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the evaluator-selected current graph and the supplied STRING parameter $seed. TRAIL permits repeated nodes but excludes repeated edges; RETURN keeps separate rows for parallel-edge paths, with no DISTINCT or list sorting. Business ids are projected in nodes(p) order with documented nodes(PATH) and transform(List, lambda). References: SKILL.md; references/patterns.md; documented-syntax.md MATCH lookup; documented-functions.md nodes/transform lookups; references/functions.md; references/identifiers.md and quote-identifiers helper; relevant validation/checklist. All generated identifiers are ordinary non-keywords per the bundled helper. No database execution performed.
